title: Prove a marked-residual stock floor and bind its reflection escape
body:
## Summary

- Prove a full-stock native rank-mass floor in the declared whole-plane native, whole-plane ADDRESS, X-translation and Gaussian scalar-bank grammar, including arbitrary dirty helpers restored to identity.
- Exhibit an actual unpaired reflection outside that grammar, with phase-correct native recipes and paid adapters. Cheap source conjugation loses the same retained progress, so this does not give a favorable complete caller.
- Correct the joint-debt query-count corollaries to **single-plane, rank-2f queries**. Two multi-plane calls can implement diag(N0N1,N0N1), while still paying four planes and rank mass 8f. Only `research/marked-residual-reflection/` changes; original proof/checker bytes and historical receipts are retained.

## Scope and limits

The typed half-chunk extension has a separate f≥2/query-alphabet boundary. General bit-linear ADDRESS, arbitrary Pauli Z, noncommuting adapters and changed targets remain outside the stock floor. Written all-parameter proofs are separate from finite Gaussian, character, normalizer and support audits.

The general floor measures native-plane count/rank mass, not the number of arbitrary-support unary queries. The [P2 review finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4056#discussion_r4313846357) is corrected in the proof and assertion message. The registered regression checks the marked-basis actions and phases of two-, three- and four-call full-pair words plus the two-call q3 split. The main rank-mass theorem is unchanged. No favorable complete caller, new κ, physical supplier admission or formal-kernel theorem is claimed.

See the [corrected proof](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b0c74ef85215d438c85b610360c67b55c5f2a15/research/marked-residual-reflection/source/q4-pauli-fusion/MARKED-RESIDUAL-GLOBAL-FLOOR.md), [coverage and limits](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b0c74ef85215d438c85b610360c67b55c5f2a15/research/marked-residual-reflection/README.md), and [task, scope change and open next questions](https://github.com/RossRichardson/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7b0c74ef85215d438c85b610360c67b55c5f2a15/research/marked-residual-reflection/TASK.json).

## Test plan

All new local evidence below is bound to `7b0c74ef85215d438c85b610360c67b55c5f2a15`.

- [x] Fresh registered normal/optimized replay: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/marked-residual-reflection`. All existing replay stages and the new query-count controls pass.
- [x] Committed bytes, metadata/pins and source history: `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/marked-residual-reflection --check-source-history` and the registered runner's `--check-only` mode pass.
- [x] Official package export/integrity and read-only Git-free `python3.12 -I -B verify.py` / `python3.12 -I -O -B verify.py` pass with empty PATH; exported bytes remain unchanged.
- [x] Separate AI delta review confirms the single-plane restriction, two-/three-call counterexamples, exact original-file preservation and unchanged historical receipts. AI review is not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.
- [x] [Automatic CI run 39257830364](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39257830364) completed successfully at this exact head, including planning and registered package replay. Full workflow status/conclusion and source SHA were read back; no manual rerun was requested.
